title: Retractable hooks and garment rod, 10-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass, Fresno Collection Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with a retractable hooks and garment rod that pulls out when you need it and retracts when you don’t. This wall-mount, straight-bar design is crafted from solid brass and coordinates with the Fresno collection for a crisp, modern look.

Highlights:
- Pullout rod extends for convenient hanging and retracts to save space
- Installs in an end wall or door frame; concealed screw mounting hardware
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Part of the Fresno collection for matching Fresno and coordinated modern bath accessories
- Available in a wide variety of designer lifetime finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Rod length / projection: 10-Inch
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Included: Brass rod, rod housing, installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Note: Requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract.

_previous.title: Fresno Collection Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
